newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady, buoyed by crude, swaps.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady, buoyed by crude, swaps.

text.p: NWE physical naphtha ended steady on Friday, but traders said prices were firmly underpinned by a sharp rally in crude oil and continued buying interest in swaps.
Cargo trading was very quiet and balanced, and the strong swaps prices were seen as offsetting what traders said was end user demand that was satisfied for now.
Nov swaps ended $3 higher at $219/$220 with the Dec lagging and rising only $1 to $211/$212, traders said.
A Scandanavian trader, without elaborating, said there were inquiries for lighter LVN material of 80 paraffinic grade, while Russian materials were on offer.
